description: Brex is a financial operations platform for businesses, offering corporate cards, expense management, bill pay, travel, reimbursements, and business banking. It also provides developer integrations for automating spend, payments, onboarding referrals, accounting, and related finance workflows.
summary: Brex exposes a REST API at https://api.brex.com documented on developer.brex.com, plus an OAuth-protected MCP server at https://api.brex.com/mcp; no Brex-hosted GraphQL API or standalone CLI was found.
